description: Bound the reviewers' diff so a pull request that deletes thousands of files no longer overflows the review prompt: bulk deletions and generated files are summarised by count and sample, and the inlined diff is capped by size with the omitted sections listed by directory.
goal: In apps/sandbox-executor, post-process the review diff in review_request.py before any reviewer prompt is built, for both the full review (build_scoped_diff, used by build_review_request) and the own-diff delta review (build_delta_request in flow/review/delta_review_request.py). (1) A file whose deletion sits in a directory holding at least 25 deleted files is not inlined: the diff names that directory with its deleted-file count, a sample of five paths, and the rule that a bulk deletion is judged by its count and sample. (2) A file whose path matches a generated pattern (*.lock, package-lock.json, *.min.js, *.map) is summarised the same way by count and sample and never inlined. (3) Every other file section is inlined in full, in git order, until the inlined text would exceed 400000 bytes; sections that do not fit are not cut mid-way but left out and listed by parent directory with their file counts. A diff that needs none of these rules is returned byte-identical to git diff output. The module line budgets (holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json and the budget check scripts) are frozen: do not edit them, and keep each touched module within its existing budget.
rationale: A pull request that deletes thousands of files produces a diff of several megabytes, so every reviewer prompt exceeds the model context limit before review starts and the review loop fails with 'Prompt is too long' in both full and own-diff modes. Summarising bulk deletions keeps every substantive change in front of the reviewers while the prompt stays bounded.
acceptance_criteria: A diff with 2000 deleted files in one directory and one modified source file yields a review diff that inlines the modified file in full, names the directory with its deleted-file count and at most five sample paths, states the summarisation rule, and contains none of the deleted files' content lines.
Deletions in a directory with fewer than 25 deleted files, and every non-deleted non-generated file, are inlined in full.
Files matching the generated patterns are summarised by count and sample and never inlined.
When the inlined text would exceed 400000 bytes, the sections that do not fit are left out whole and listed by parent directory with file counts; no section is cut mid-way.
A diff that needs none of these rules is returned byte-identical to git diff output, from build_scoped_diff and from the delta request path.
build_delta_request in delta_review_request.py builds its diff through the same bounding step, and the existing review tests, including test_delta_review.py, pass unchanged.
The new test_review_request_bulk_diff.py runs under uv run pytest and covers the rules above on git repositories built in a temporary directory.
No change to holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json or to any budget-check script.
The review_request.py module holds the bounding step, and build_scoped_diff in review_request.py returns the bounded text.
